name: plans
title: Plans and prices
when: the visitor asks what it costs, or which plan to choose

steps.say: Here are our three plans: one monthly price instead of a surprise bill.
Essential is nineteen dollars a month, with two cleanings a year and X-rays.
Family Care is the one most families pick: up to four people, for thirty-nine dollars a month.
Complete adds a whitening every year and an aligner consult, for fifty-nine dollars.
When you know which one fits you, press its button, and you are set.
